headline: Balaji Telefilms files minutes from September AGM
hook: Annual meeting minutes filed for Balaji Telefilms
summary: Balaji Telefilms Limited has submitted the official minutes of its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the NSE. This filing provides a formal record of the proceedings and resolutions passed during the meeting. The document is now available for public review on the exchange portal.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory compliance with no immediate impact on share price.
